title: This Whale Lives 200 Years and Breaks Through Arctic Ice

scenes.text: This whale smashes through Arctic ice with its head.
It's the bowhead, up to 80 tonnes, with the biggest head for its body of any whale.
It can break through sea ice half a meter thick.
Bowheads can live up to 200 years, longer than any other whale.
In 2007, whalers found an 1800s harpoon tip lodged in the neck of one.
That whale had carried it for about a century. Two hundred years of Arctic ice, and the ice loses.
